MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The 32GB microSD card with an adapter fits my repeated use of memory cards and a card reader, so it feels like a useful addition to equipment I already use.",
    "The longer HDMI cable fits my history of buying practical cables and adapters, although I would check the connections and length I need before choosing it."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The older Fire tablet offers little benefit because I already have a newer Fire 7; another tablet is not the same kind of useful addition as a memory card.",
    "The Echo speakers and smart display assume I want Alexa devices, while my purchases mostly show specific accessories for existing equipment.",
    "Owning a TV does not mean I currently want streaming sticks, and I have no stated coverage problem or headphone replacement need to make the extender or earbuds timely choices."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been treated as interest in a wider range of Amazon devices, rather than a reason to suggest compatible accessories.",
    "My TV purchase seems to have been treated as an ongoing interest in entertainment devices, even though my later purchases emphasize practical equipment needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of memory cards, storage cases, cables, mounts and power strips suggest that helping me use and maintain existing equipment matters right now.",
    "Compatibility and a concrete purpose matter: my latest lens cap purchase names a specific size, while an older tablet or an additional screen does not solve an evident need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in memory cards and useful cables, but stretched my device ownership into interest in additional gadgets without a current purpose."
}
